actionResult.summary: Review 051 propose：Current/Planned/Actual 时间边界、Delivery-scoped JSON/HTML authority、scoped architecture/.gitignore、exact managed Archify --repo-root seam、thin render/compare 与 future-Delivery genericity 均正确承接 050 approved Explore；Proposal package SHA256、OpenSpec strict 19/19、apply/revise-apply mutationDeclaration dry admission 与 staging-aware diff hygiene均通过。但 051 的 Change Verification capability relation 尚未闭合：Apply mutation scope 明确修改 src/cli/architecture.ts、src/cli/main.ts、tests/unit/cli/architecture.test.ts，这些路径继续由 cli-diagnostics ownership；Base cli-diagnostics.capabilityIds 与本 Change 三个 delta capability 均不相交。按当前 buildVerificationSelection() 每个 seed module 必须匹配一个当前 delta capability 的硬规则，按 051 当前 Design 仅新增 architecture module 后，formal selection 在 cli-diagnostics seed 上稳定 fail closed。该问题属于 author-owned Proposal contract gap，需要 revise-propose 冻结 CLI-owned D1 paths 的 capability relation，并用 next-consumer dry selection 证明 closure。

reviewFindings.title: CLI-owned D1 mutation paths 缺少可匹配的 OpenSpec delta capability relation
reviewFindings.problem: 051 Apply mutation scope 明确包含 src/cli/architecture.ts、src/cli/main.ts 与 tests/unit/cli/architecture.test.ts，同时 Design 决定 src/cli/** 继续由现有 cli-diagnostics Verification module ownership。Base 上 cli-diagnostics.capabilityIds 仅包含 flowkit-change-cli-end-to-end-and-performance、flowkit-diagnostic-cli、flowkit-openspec-1-7-thin-integration、flowkit-policy-engine、flowkit-runtime-foundation；051 当前 OpenSpec delta capability 只有 flowkit-architecture-assets、flowkit-change-verification-selection、flowkit-external-tool-runtime。两者无交集。当前 buildVerificationSelection() 对每个 seed module 强制要求至少命中一个当前 delta capability，所以按 051 当前 Design 只新增 architecture module/check 后，formal Apply Verification 会在 cli-diagnostics seed 上 fail closed。
reviewFindings.contractRef: 051 design.md Decisions 7-8 / flowkit-change-verification-selection delta spec；Base src/verification/change-selection/selection.ts buildVerificationSelection() seed capability relation；Flowkit Explore Skill v2 Mutation Surface + Verification Closure
reviewFindings.invariant: Proposal 冻结的 Apply mutation surface 中，每个实际 seed Verification module 必须与当前 OpenSpec delta capability 有合法关系，并能进入 physical selected-check closure；不能只证明 path ownership/selector 唯一而忽略 capability admission。
evidence: 051 flowkitMutationScope: src/cli/architecture.ts、src/cli/main.ts、tests/unit/cli/architecture.test.ts 均为 Apply/revise-apply authorized paths。
051 Design Decision 7: src/cli/** ownership 保持 cli-diagnostics，不归新 architecture module。

Base cli-diagnostics.capabilityIds = flowkit-change-cli-end-to-end-and-performance / flowkit-diagnostic-cli / flowkit-openspec-1-7-thin-integration / flowkit-policy-engine / flowkit-runtime-foundation。

Reviewer disposable next-consumer simulation：按 051 Design 新增 architecture module、tests-architecture 与 closed capability/check，但不额外改变 cli-diagnostics capability relation；对包含 architecture JSON + src/architecture + src/cli/architecture.ts + src/cli/main.ts + Archify adapter + verification mapping 的 hypothetical actualChangeSet 调用 buildVerificationSelection()，稳定得到 VERIFICATION_CAPABILITY_SELECTION_FAILED，context.moduleId=cli-diagnostics。

同一 simulation 仅在为 cli-diagnostics 建立与 D1 delta 的合法 capability relation 后即可形成 matched selection，并同时选择 tests-architecture/tests-cli/tests-external-tools/tests-openspec-runtime/tests-verification/typecheck。
reviewFindings.impact: 若按 051 直接进入 Apply，代码和 tests 即使全部实现正确，formal Change Verification selection 仍会在 capability admission 阶段失败，重复 C1 中“Proposal 文案通过但 next-stage machine consumer fail closed”的问题。
reviewFindings.requiredOutcome: 最小 revise-propose 冻结 CLI-owned D1 paths 与当前 D1 OpenSpec delta capability 的合法 relation，同时保持 src/cli/** ownership 不重叠。实现选择由 Author 决定；例如可让 cli-diagnostics 明确承认 flowkit-architecture-assets capability，并补对应 module-map contract/tests。Proposal 必须增加一个 read-only next-consumer dry selection：使用预期 D1 actualChangeSet + 三个 D1 delta capability refs，buildVerificationSelection() 成功且所有 seed module 均有 applicable capability relation。
acceptance: 包含这些 CLI paths 的预期 D1 actualChangeSet 与 051 三个 delta capability refs 调用 buildVerificationSelection() 不再抛 VERIFICATION_CAPABILITY_SELECTION_FAILED。
selection.capabilityRelation = matched，seedModuleIds 中 cli-diagnostics 有明确 applicable D1 capability。
formal selection 仍能覆盖 tests-cli，并在完整 D1 mutation set 上同时覆盖 tests-architecture 与其他 affected checks。
不通过扩大为新 Registry/第二 Verification system 解决。
